tasks.short: Develop school communication and swallowing programmes

steps.what: Review school needs and capture individual or group programme constraints
Select activities and decide individual or group arrangements and safeguards
Assemble selected activities into programmes for school staff
Approve programme suitability and share the exact final plan with authorised school staff

tasks.design: Use selected activity blocks in {DOCS} to assemble the school programme. The pathologist decides grouping and safeguards, checks the complete plan and shares only its approved version through the {OTHER} clinical record portal.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing recurring instructions takes time after clinical and school choices are made.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document blocks can reuse agreed instructions without making clinical decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Swallowing risk, individual suitability and practical school supervision.
tasks.human_edge: Balancing safety, participation and what school staff can deliver.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated document assembly; clinical and school decisions stay human.

reach.task: Agree access arrangements for a school activity
reach.learn: School accessibility constraints and professional scope

evidence.claim: Clinician-selected document-block assembly is an E1 proposal; the digest does not establish automated school programme design.

assumptions: Boundary is school programme development, excluding assessment, delivery and separately counted individual exercise programmes. A roll-up assigns overlapping assembly savings once.

The pathologist produces goals, pupil identifiers, permissions, safety limits and school constraints in fully retained s1. In fully retained s2 the pathologist supplies activity identifiers, grouping, frequency and stop conditions.
No swallowing exercise or safety instruction is inferred automatically. Missing approved blocks require manual drafting in s3.
Test native document templates before custom code; authorised portal access is required and manual permitted sharing is the fallback.
unknowns: Local professional scope and school sharing permissions
research_questions: How often can school instructions be reused without changing clinical meaning?

already_counted.description: Final safety, disclosure and programme approval

incremental.description: Maintain approved activity blocks and portal permissions

approvals.approved_version: Exact programme, pupils or group, activity doses, safeguards and recipient list; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=25+35+25*0.50+15=87.5; gross=12.5, upkeep=2, net=10.5. High assumes reusable activities; low assumes mostly bespoke plans with only 2 gross hours offsetting upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct therapeutic lessons and games with teachers

steps.what: Conduct lessons and therapeutic games, demonstrate techniques and adapt to participant responses

tasks.design: Retain live lessons and therapeutic games with the clinician. The {DOCS} lesson plan supports delivery, but its separate preparation is outside this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching depends on observing responses and modelling appropriate interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing materials can support the lesson without substituting for responsive delivery.
tasks.still_hard: Spotting an ineffective technique and changing it safely in the moment.
tasks.human_edge: Modelling communication, coaching teachers and responding to pupils.
tasks.altitude: Delivery time and responsibility are unchanged.

reach.task: Adapt a therapeutic game for accessible participation

evidence.claim: Retaining responsive therapeutic teaching is an E1 judgement, with no measured labour saving claimed.

assumptions: Boundary is live delivery; planning and administrative records belong to separate tasks.
The pathologist produces observations through the fully retained interaction; no structured score or transcript is assumed.
Zero upkeep because this design introduces no change.
research_questions: Which delivery activities require joint observation by a teacher and clinician?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and upkeep=0. All lesson and game delivery remains human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide communication instruction for dialect and limited-English speakers

steps.what: Select and assemble suitable communication examples for the student's learning goals
Provide communication instruction and adapt examples to the student's responses

tasks.design: Configure searchable, approved example sets in {DOCS} to reduce repeated copying. The pathologist selects and checks examples, then delivers culturally appropriate instruction and adapts it in person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suitable examples are repeatedly located and assembled for a lesson.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tagging and reusable blocks can support assembly without judging dialect or generating a diagnosis.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing language difference from disorder and respecting the student's communication goals.
tasks.human_edge: Building confidence and adjusting to cultural and linguistic context.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less example assembly; instruction remains fully retained.

reach.task: Align communication practice with everyday participation goals

evidence.claim: Searching and assembling approved example blocks is an E1 proposal; the digest provides no dialect-specific instructional product or saving.

assumptions: Boundary includes immediate example preparation and instruction, excluding clinical assessment and general language teaching elsewhere.

The pathologist identifies target skill, language context, example identifiers and accessibility needs in s1. Selection, tagging needed for this lesson and suitability checks remain in its 13 retained hours.
Existing library entries require no new student data. Missing or unsuitable examples are drafted manually within s1; test native document search first.
Dialect and limited English proficiency are not assumed to be disorders. Local scope and voluntary learning goals need confirmation.
research_questions: Does reusable example assembly save time after cultural and linguistic checks?

already_counted.description: Example selection, capture and suitability checks

incremental.description: Maintain example tags and check library suitability

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=20*0.65+80=93; gross=7, upkeep=2, net=5. High assumes reusable examples; low assumes scarce coverage leaving only 2 gross hours to offset upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather existing work samples and learning objectives for supervision
Supervise students or assistants, observe practice and give corrective feedback

tasks.design: Use saved folders and access-limited views in {DOCS} and the {OTHER} clinical record to gather existing supervision material. Keep observation, competence judgements, feedback and delegation decisions with the pathologist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing evidence is scattered across folders and records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filtered views can reduce retrieval without assessing competence automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unsafe practice and judging readiness for greater responsibility.
tasks.human_edge: Direct observation, corrective coaching and accountable delegation.
tasks.altitude: Less retrieval before supervision; supervision decisions remain unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate supervision where an assistant supports shared patient care

evidence.claim: Access-controlled evidence retrieval is an E1 configuration proposal, not evidence for automated supervision.

assumptions: Boundary is the pathologist's preparation and supervision; existing student work is an input, not saved student labour.

Students and assistants produce work samples during existing practice. The pathologist checks identity, permitted access, learning objective and sample relevance in s1, with all capture included in its five retained hours.
No new structured competence ratings are required from students. Missing or poorly indexed samples require manual retrieval; test native views first.
unknowns: How much evidence retrieval occurs today
research_questions: Can saved views reduce preparation without missing important adverse observations?

already_counted.description: Sample selection, permissions and missing evidence checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=10*0.50+90=95; gross=5, upkeep=1, net=4. High assumes scattered but retrievable samples; low assumes manual exceptions leave only 1 gross hour offsetting upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: School programme assembly and supervision preparation may shrink; live teaching and clinical decisions remain human.
reach: Coordinate school access needs with occupational therapy
Agree delegation boundaries with nursing colleagues
role.ambitious_version: Use modest preparation savings for more tailored coaching of teachers and assistants.
